meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, including RRBs, June 2017 to December 2022
meta.coverage: Commercial banks at a glance (statement 1): banks and offices, growth of deposits and credit by bank group and population group, and the credit-deposit ratio, every quarter from June 2017 to December 2022, including regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1463 (data provider DP8), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Payments banks, credit growth on a year earlier, per cent on 2022-09-01).
